items.taglish: Grabe, ang dami kong deadline this week, parang hindi ako makakatulog.
items.paraphrase: Wow, I have so many deadlines this week, I feel like I won't be able to sleep.
items.distractor: Need to buy cat food and refill the water fountain before Saturday.

items.taglish: Sinabi ni boss na kailangan i-submit yung report bago mag-Friday, kaya mag-OT ako mamaya.
items.paraphrase: My boss said I need to submit the report before Friday, so I'll be working overtime later.
items.distractor: That plot twist in the finale was unexpected, might rewatch the whole series.

items.taglish: Ang tagal ng meeting kanina, ang dami nilang tinalakay pero wala namang nangyari sa huli.
items.paraphrase: That meeting earlier was so tedious, they discussed so many things but nothing actually happened in the end.
items.distractor: Recipe idea — try ube cheese pandesal next weekend, need more instant yeast.

items.taglish: Sabi ni mama, dadalaw daw sila this weekend kaya kailangan nating i-clean yung buong bahay.
items.paraphrase: Mom said they're supposedly visiting this weekend, so we need to clean the whole house.
items.distractor: Phone battery draining so fast lately, might need to replace it soon.

items.taglish: Ang cute ng pamangkin ko, ang bilis niyang lumaki, parang kailan lang siya baby pa.
items.paraphrase: Ang cute ng pamangkin ko, ang bilis niyang lumaki, para bang kailan lang siya sanggol pa.
items.distractor: Car's due for an oil change, also check when the LTO registration expires.

items.taglish: Late na ako pero kailangan ko pa ring tumawag kay papa kasi worried siya kapag hindi ako nag-uupdate.
items.paraphrase: I'm already late but I still need to call dad because he gets worried when I don't give updates.
items.distractor: Legs are so sore from yesterday's leg day, should stretch more next time.

items.taglish: Gutom na gutom na ako, tara kumain tayo sa may kanto, gusto ko ng something spicy.
items.paraphrase: Gutom na gutom na ako, tara kumain tayo sa may kanto, gusto ko ng maanghang.
items.distractor: Savings goal — set aside more from each payday for the new laptop.

items.taglish: Ang sarap ng adobo ni lola, hindi ko talaga ma-recreate yung taste kahit sinusubukan ko na maraming beses.
items.paraphrase: Grandma's adobo is so delicious, I really can't recreate that taste even though I've tried many times.
items.distractor: Kitchen faucet is leaking again, need to call the plumber this week.

items.taglish: Order na lang tayo ng food delivery mamaya, ayoko nang magluto, sobrang pagod ko na.
items.paraphrase: Let's just order food delivery later, I don't want to cook anymore, I'm so tired already.
items.distractor: That book's plot twist in chapter 12 caught me off guard, need to finish it this week.

items.taglish: Grabe ang init ngayon, kahit naka-aircon dito sa loob parang nasusunog pa rin ako.
items.paraphrase: Wow it's so hot today, even with the aircon on in here I still feel like I'm burning up.
items.distractor: Grocery list — eggs, rice, dish soap, toothpaste, cooking oil, check Shopee for a sale first.

items.taglish: Baka umulan mamaya, maitim na kasi yung ulap, dapat magdala ka ng payong just in case.
items.paraphrase: It might rain later, the clouds are already dark, you should bring an umbrella just in case.
items.distractor: Assignment is due Monday, still need to finish the last two pages.

items.taglish: Gusto ko sana mag-out of town this weekend, pero baka wala akong budget kasi marami akong binayaran this month.
items.paraphrase: I was hoping to go out of town this weekend, but I might not have the budget because I paid for a lot of things this month.
items.distractor: Dentist appointment reminder — bring the old x-rays this time.

items.taglish: Balak ko sanang mag-enroll ulit sa gym, para may gagawin ako after work kesa nakaupo lang buong araw.
items.paraphrase: I'm planning to enroll in the gym again, so I have something to do after work instead of just sitting all day.
items.distractor: Passport expires in six months, should renew before booking any flights.

items.taglish: Pag-uwi ko galing trabaho, sana matulog na lang ako agad kasi ang hirap ng araw ko ngayon.
items.paraphrase: When I get home from work, I hope I can just sleep right away because today was such a hard day.
items.distractor: Plants on the balcony need watering twice a week during summer.

items.taglish: Ang bagal ng internet dito, paulit-ulit akong na-disconnect tuwing may online meeting.
items.paraphrase: The internet here is so slow, I keep getting disconnected every time there's an online meeting.
items.distractor: Still deciding between a wallet or a watch for her birthday gift.

items.taglish: Sobrang traffic kanina sa EDSA, dalawang oras akong nakaupo lang sa sasakyan, di ako makagalaw.
items.paraphrase: The traffic on EDSA earlier was so bad, I just sat in the car for two hours, unable to move.
items.distractor: Finally hit a 30-day streak on the language app, vocabulary's improving.

items.taglish: Ang tagal na naming hinihintay yung sinabi nilang refund, wala pa rin kahit ilang linggo na ang nakalipas.
items.paraphrase: We've been waiting so long for the refund they promised, still nothing even after several weeks.
items.distractor: Knitting project is halfway done, running low on the blue yarn though.

items.taglish: Kumusta ka na? Ang tagal na nating hindi nagkita, dapat mag-usap tayo ulit minsan.
items.paraphrase: Kamusta ka na? Sobrang tagal na nating hindi nagkikita, dapat talaga tayong mag-usap ulit balang-araw.
items.distractor: Random fact — octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.

items.taglish: Did you see her post kanina? Sobrang nakaka-relate, I literally laughed out loud.
items.paraphrase: Did you see her post earlier? It was so relatable, I literally laughed out loud.
items.distractor: Streaming subscription renews next week via GCash, should cancel if not using it anymore.

items.taglish: Chill lang tayo later, after work, kape lang, no agenda, gusto ko lang mag-unwind.
items.paraphrase: Let's just chill later, after work, just coffee, no agenda, I just want to unwind.
items.distractor: New shelf still needs to be assembled, missing one of the screws.

input.note: 20 Taglish/paraphrase/distractor triples, measured against the real Xenova/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 model (the multilingual opt-in, M5) -- the coverage claim these numbers support is scoped to that model, not the English-only default. Content pipeline: computational-linguist agent drafted 20 items across 7 everyday topics (grammatically verified: correct particle placement and verb affixation on English roots, e.g. mag-OT/na-disconnect/mag-enroll, attested colloquial patterns); localization-specialist agent then reviewed for register authenticity, corrected 3 items (item 2's 'mag-oovertime' to the near-universal texted short form 'mag-OT'; item 3's false-friend 'hirap' -> 'tagal' for 'tedious', since 'hirap' means difficult/hard and item 14 already uses it correctly for that sense; item 5's TL paraphrase 'ang ganda' -> kept 'ang cute', since beautiful is not a paraphrase of cute and would have corrupted the pair's ground truth), and authored one topically-unrelated English distractor per item. All 20 reviewed by both agents; none required rejecting entirely.
input.registerCaveat: Reviewed and flagged explicitly by the localization-specialist: all 20 items are one register band -- urban, casual, moderate-code-switch-density, Tagalog-based chat/text voice. NOT tested: regional-language-inflected code-switching (Bisaya/Cebuano, Ilocano, Hiligaynon, etc., spoken by a large share of the country), formal/professional Filipino register, or heavy-abbreviation text-speak. The specialist's explicit recommendation, followed here: do not let a pass read as a blanket 'verified for Filipino' -- scope the coverage-table note to the specific register actually tested.

assertion: For each of the 20 items, cosine(Taglish, correct paraphrase) clearly exceeds cosine(Taglish, unrelated distractor) when measured against the real multilingual model. The fixture's overall verdict.passed is true only if every item individually passes (a single failing item means the discriminability claim doesn't hold uniformly, and should not be papered over by an average). Live-recomputed cosines for a sample of items must match their pinned snapshots within a small epsilon.

closestMargin.note: razor-thin pass -- 'Pag-uwi ko galing trabaho...' scored paraphrase 0.0640 vs distractor 0.0633; every other item cleared by a wide margin (next-closest gap was 0.021)

verdict.evidence: 20/20 items passed the discriminability test (cosine(Taglish, correct paraphrase) > cosine(Taglish, unrelated)) against Xenova/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2, average gap 0.428. This supports 'the model can tell a Taglish sentence's real paraphrase apart from an unrelated sentence' (a ranking/discriminability claim) -- not 'the model understands Taglish' (a semantic-accuracy claim); cosine similarity is not semantic equivalence.
verdict.note: Verified for urban, casual Taglish chat register only (this fixture's 20 items) — not tested against regional-language-inflected code-switching (Bisaya/Cebuano, Ilocano, Hiligaynon, etc.), formal Filipino, or heavy-abbreviation text-speak. Measured against the multilingual model (opt-in); the default English-only model was never claimed to support Filipino.
